data.name: Casino Simulator: Vendetta
data.detailed_description:
Rise from a street-level thug to a key player in the ruthless underworld. You proved your worth by executing high-stakes assassinations for the Baron and his council, earning your very own casino as a reward. But this glamorous new life shattered into a dark nightmare on opening night. A rival boss orchestrated a brutal hit on your establishment, leaving your sister dead in your arms.

  Now, left with nothing but a rundown underground warehouse, your mission is clear: Transform this dump into the city's most profitable secret casino, earn the big Baron's respect, and exact your brutal revenge on the man who took your sister!

                       

                      

  Nothing in your casino happens by chance. Where you place each slot machine and the layout of your tables directly impact your earnings. While you customize the colors and look to fit your style, you must balance various dynamic factors that determine customer satisfaction and profit margins. Turn a rundown dump into a highly lucrative empire. Hire waitstaff, manage chip cashiers, and constantly expand your operation.

                       

                      

  Your phone could ring at any moment. Deal with unexpected crises, special VIPs, and thugs trying to shake down your joint. Step behind the counter when needed, but always be ready to draw your weapon, defend your turf, and pull the trigger without hesitation.

                       

                      

  This isn't a legitimate business. You need to find a way to wash the massive off-the-books income you generate underground. Keep your surface-level "car wash" front operational. Wash cars daily to avoid suspicion and keep up the appearance of an ordinary local business. Launder your dirty money to fund your criminal empire and rise to the top.

                       

                      

  The local mafia always wants their cut and will knock on your door every day. However, their respect for your ruthless past offers a unique opportunity. Visit the mafia's own shooting range and show them your skills haven't faded. Based on the score you achieve at the range, they will grant you a discount on your daily tribute out of respect for the old days. Shoot straight, prove your lethality, and protect your vault!

                       

  • Control the Payouts: Adjust the win/loss rates of your slot machines. Let the customers win occasionally to keep them hooked, but always ensure the house wins in the end.

  • Deep Customization: Design every detail of your casino, from wall paint to carpet colors, to match your personal style.

  • Hands-on Management: Don't be afraid to get your hands dirty early on; take out the trash and personally serve your customers when needed.

  • Staff & Talent Management: Delegate the daily grind as you grow. Hire waiters, cashiers, security guards, and highly skilled dealers to automate the operation and run your empire like a true boss.

  • Financial Strategy: Take out bank loans to survive crises or to fund your next big expansion.

  • Auction System: Participate in secret auctions via your smartphone to acquire rare items for your establishment.

  • Comprehensive Upgrades: Upgrade every piece of equipment, machine, and furniture to multiply your daily earnings.

  • Underground Atmosphere Control: Since your joint is underground, you must carefully manage the ventilation, oxygen levels, and temperature to keep your customers comfortable.

  • Camera & Intel: Snap photos with the in-game camera and send them to your contacts to trigger events and unlock new opportunities.

data.short_description: Build and manage your underground casino empire from the ground up while rising through the criminal ranks. Earn the Baron’s trust, expand your operations, and avenge your sister’s death.

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 7600K / Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains infrequent scenes of violence and murder tied to a revenge storyline, alongside themes of running an illegal underground casino. There is no sexual content.
